marks.gloss_en: אמר ליה אביי: לימא מר מפני שהוא עף -- let the Master give the reason that it is volatile
חדא ועוד קאמר: one [reason] -- because it is volatile; and further -- a decree lest he take from it
[it is forbidden] because it is volatile
a mother-in-law who hated her daughter-in-law told her to adorn herself with balsam oil and then to light the lamp; fire caught her and consumed her
'vinedressers' (Jer 52:16) -- these are the balsam gatherers from Ein Gedi to Ramta
בשתי תרומות הכתוב מדבר... מה תרומה טהורה אין לך בה אלא משעת הרמה ואילך, אף תרומה טמאה אין לך בה אלא משעת הרמה ואילך
אבל טבל טמא מאי טעמא? אמר קרא... -- the answer to why impure tevel may not be lit with is the derivation that impure teruma is the priest's only from its separation onward
the reason for impure tevel is the verse 'and I, behold, I have given you the charge of My terumot' (Num 18:8)
one may not light with impure tevel on a weekday
R' Shimon ben Elazar: one may not light with tzori

one may light with fish oil
